what_is_cs.timeline_title: A quick history of couch surfing

timeline.early_2000s_text: The online couch surfing movement is born: stay with locals, share culture.
timeline.2010s_text: Communities and events flourish; references build trust — the world starts to feel like one friendly neighborhood.
timeline.2020_text: A major platform goes for‑profit; Couchers.org launches as the nonprofit, community‑run alternative.
timeline.today_text: The next chapter: modern, safer, nonprofit couch surfing — built by and for the community.

points.trust: <bold>Community-driven trust system –</bold> Every member has a profile with references and reviews from people they’ve met, so you can see real experiences before deciding to connect.
points.verification: <bold>Verification & identity checks –</bold> Members can choose strong verification (ID, phone, email) to confirm they are who they say they are, giving an extra layer of confidence.
points.moderation: <bold>Active moderation & safety tools –</bold> A moderation team monitors reports, and you can block or report anyone at any time. Safety tips and guidelines are built into the platform so you’re always in control of your experience.

team.title: The Team
team.description: We are all couch surfers and skilled professionals who want to build an improved, safer and more inclusive platform that can support and sustainably grow the couch surfing community and bring its values to the world. If you feel the same way and want to contribute, then we'd love to talk to you.

team.fill_form_description: Couchers.org is a community project, built by folks like you for the benefit of the global couch surfing community. If you would like to be a part of this great new project, or leave your feedback on our ideas, click the button below and fill out the short form.
